version.description:
Version number used for optimistic concurrency.  Automatically managed by the system.

Updating an Obj with a null or 0 value for version will cause the concurrency check to be skipped and should only
be done with great caution.

typeWithBindings.description: Persists concrete type with bindings for generic types where instance has parameter bindings

error.description:
Any errors occurring during the normalization are stored here. When this timeseries is read, if there exists
an error then the error will be thrown to the user

schemaVersion.description:
Schema version decides whether the structure of the timeseries are compatible with each other.
If the normalization engine expects a different version number, it forces re-normalization

treatment.description:
Stores the `treatment` used to normalize this timeseries. This information is required during
aggregation / disaggregation when the timeseries is being read

unitId.description: Stores the unit associated with this timeseries

buckets.description: buckets for the existing normalized timeseries

partitionStrategy.description: Config state when this row was written

title:
Corresponding to every NormalizedTimeseries object there is a NormalizedTimeseriesState object that gets created.
This object gives us information about whether the given timeseries is valid and consumable.
Normalization engine relies on this type to figure out if it has to re-normalize the timeseries
One object per header-field combination exists for this type
name: NormalizedTimeseriesState
